product_metadata.title: Freshware 2-in-1 Onion, Vegetable, Fruit, and Cheese Chopper
features: Dice or chop in one swift motion by closing lid
Reduces onion vapors to minimize tears in a storage container. Holds up to 4 cups or 1.2 liters
2 sharp inter-changeable stainless-steel blades for dicing and chopping. 1 storage container and 1 cleaning tool included
BPA, PVC and Phthalate FREE. Top Rack Dishwasher Safe. Hand wash recommended
description: Work smarter, not harder in the kitchen with the Freshware KT-402 2-in-1 Onion, Vegetable, Fruit and Cheese Chopper. Constructed with BPA, PVC and Phthalate Free material. No longer will you have to chop and dice onions with all the crying, mess, odor, and clean-up. Nope, just slice an onion or any firm vegetable in two; set half on the stainless-steel blade, then close the top lid. Voila, your vegetable or cheese is now chopped, cut and stored easily for you.

This compact tool stands on non-slip foot that keeps it secure on the countertop or table. When the top lid is closed, the blade is protected and safely tucked away from a busy chef's hands. It comes with 2 super sharp inter-changeable stainless-steel blades for dicing and chopping your way to a professionally prepared meal. The clear plastic container holds up to 4 cups or 1.2 liters. The storage container can be used to keep chopped vegetables fresh in the refrigerator. The cleaning tool conveniently removes onion bits from pusher teeth or blades. Hand washing recommended for extending the life of the product but it is dishwasher top rack safe. Convenient, compact and highly functional, this kitchen tool is a must-have to make food preparation a cinch.
